evidence_quotes.agenda: Now before we kind of dive in, I just wanted to ask, what are the most important things that I can answer for you on the call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised critter/spider worry from prior storage experience; rep gave one reassurance ('I haven't heard of that happening...') with no real second-layer follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: you only pay for the time you use so if they get closer to I don't know, four to five hours then that's all you end up paying for

top_strength: Very personalized, well-reasoned estimate anchor built directly off the customer's specific storage-unit details (size, fill level, indoor/first floor).
coaching_note: Never delivered damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, or Communication anywhere in a 26-minute call, and never closed with a rate-lock or explicit ask -- the differentiators and the close both got lost in a long logistics conversation.
